background: Close Brothers Group is a UK merchant banking group, funded by retail and corporate deposits and lending on motor finance, asset finance, invoice finance and property development.
synthesis: Two of the three main agencies rate the group, BBB on average and both on a negative outlook, after a one-notch downgrade by one of the three on 17 Oct 2025; the ratings, not the balance sheet, are the weak spot. Capital is sound against UK mid-sized banks, CET1 of 14.1% just below the peer median and leverage of 13.5% in the top quarter. Liquidity is very strong, LCR of 1114% and NSFR of 144% both in the top quarter. Since 31 Jul 2025 leverage has risen 0.6 points and LCR 102 points.
